title: The chief second liner: looking after children and enjoying parades
summary: White claims to be chief of all second liners, tells how he brought children home safely, and describes parades in summer and winter.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs
